en.title: How to Compress an Image for an Online Application
en.description: Reduce a photo to an application portal's file-size limit while protecting readability, dimensions and your original file.
en.imageAlt: Image compression settings and before-after file sizes
en.opening: A rejected upload often has a simple cause: the photo is larger than the portal allows. The safe response is not to keep taking screenshots until the file becomes blurry. Start from the original and reduce dimensions, format or quality in a controlled sequence.
en.answer: For most application photos, keep the required aspect ratio, resize only as far as the portal permits, export a fresh JPEG or WebP when accepted, and inspect small text, facial detail and edges at normal zoom before upload.
en.toolIntro: lets you compare the original and compressed file in your browser and target a practical file size.
en.quick: Copy the portal's accepted format, maximum size and pixel requirements into a note. Compress a duplicate, not the only original. If the first export misses the limit, lower dimensions or quality one step at a time and recheck the result.
inputs: The current upload instruction, including KB or MB
JPEG, PNG, WebP or another format named by the portal
Minimum, maximum or exact width and height
Face, signature, stamp, document text or product detail
en.inputNote: KB and MB are not interchangeable, and a portal may enforce both file size and pixel dimensions. Check both before exporting.
steps: Open the receiving portal and record its current upload rules.
Duplicate the original image and open the copy in the compressor.
Choose the accepted format and preserve the required aspect ratio.
Reduce dimensions or quality gradually while watching the estimated output size.
Download, reopen and inspect the exported image, then upload only the verified copy.
details: Photos usually tolerate moderate lossy compression better than scans containing small text, line art or signatures. PNG can preserve sharp edges and transparency but may be larger. JPEG is widely accepted for photos but does not preserve transparency. WebP can be efficient, although the portal must explicitly accept it.

Do not judge quality only from the preview thumbnail. Reopen the downloaded file, confirm its actual size and dimensions, and zoom to the part that matters. A file below the limit is still unusable if the passport number, signature or face has become unclear.
If the portal rejects a compliant-looking file, check the filename, extension, colour mode and orientation. Retaking a screenshot can strip useful detail and metadata without solving the real rule.
checks: The exported file is below the stated limit, not merely close to it.
Width, height and aspect ratio satisfy the portal rule.
Text, faces, stamps and signatures remain readable.
The file extension matches the actual exported format.
The unchanged original remains available for another attempt.
en.safety: Application images may contain identity information. Prefer local processing, remove unnecessary copies from shared devices, and upload only through the official portal.
en.toolUse: The studio can batch files, but verify every exported item separately because different photographs respond differently to the same setting.
related: Free PDF tools for document workflows
faq: Will compression change the image dimensions?
It can. Quality compression and resizing are separate controls, so record the required pixels and check the downloaded result.
Should I use JPEG or PNG?
Use a format accepted by the destination. JPEG is often practical for photos; PNG is useful for sharp graphics or transparency but can be larger.
Can I delete the original after upload?
Keep the original until the application is accepted and safely archived. You may need a different export later.

fr.keyword: compresser une image pour une demande en ligne
fr.title: Compresser une image pour une demande en ligne
fr.description: Réduisez une photo à la limite du portail sans perdre la lisibilité, les dimensions exigées ni le fichier original.
fr.imageAlt: Réglages de compression et comparaison du poids d'une image
fr.opening: Un téléversement refusé vient souvent d'une photo trop lourde. La bonne méthode n'est pas d'accumuler des captures d'écran floues. Partez de l'original et réduisez les dimensions, le format ou la qualité de manière contrôlée.
fr.answer: Pour une photo de dossier, conservez le rapport largeur-hauteur demandé, redimensionnez uniquement dans les limites du portail, puis vérifiez le visage, le texte et les contours dans le fichier téléchargé.
fr.toolIntro: permet de comparer le fichier original et la sortie dans le navigateur et de viser un poids pratique.
fr.quick: Copiez dans une note le format accepté, le poids maximal et les dimensions. Compressez une copie. Si la première sortie reste trop lourde, réduisez la taille ou la qualité progressivement et contrôlez de nouveau.
inputs: Instruction actuelle du portail, en Ko ou Mo
JPEG, PNG, WebP ou autre format indiqué
Largeur et hauteur minimales, maximales ou exactes
Visage, signature, cachet, texte ou détail produit
fr.inputNote: Ko et Mo ne sont pas équivalents. Un portail peut contrôler à la fois le poids et les dimensions en pixels.
steps: Ouvrez le portail destinataire et notez ses règles actuelles.
Dupliquez l'image originale et ouvrez la copie dans le compresseur.
Choisissez un format accepté et conservez les proportions exigées.
Réduisez progressivement les dimensions ou la qualité en surveillant le poids.
Téléchargez, rouvrez et contrôlez la sortie avant de l'envoyer.
fr.detailTitle: Choisir le bon compromis de compression
details: Une photo supporte souvent mieux une compression avec pertes qu'un scan contenant de petits caractères, des traits ou une signature. Le PNG préserve les contours et la transparence mais peut être plus lourd. Le JPEG convient souvent aux photos. Le WebP est efficace seulement si le portail l'accepte.

Ne jugez pas la qualité sur la miniature. Rouvrez le fichier téléchargé, contrôlez son poids et ses dimensions, puis agrandissez la zone importante. Un fichier léger reste inutilisable si le visage ou le texte devient flou.
Si un fichier conforme semble refusé, contrôlez le nom, l'extension, l'orientation et le format réel. Une capture d'écran peut supprimer des détails sans corriger la règle du portail.
checks: Le fichier est clairement sous la limite annoncée.
Les dimensions et les proportions sont conformes.
Le texte, le visage, le cachet et la signature restent lisibles.
L'extension correspond au format exporté.
L'original intact est toujours disponible.
fr.safety: Une photo de dossier peut contenir des données d'identité. Préférez un traitement local et utilisez uniquement le portail officiel pour l'envoi.
fr.toolUse: Le traitement par lot est possible, mais vérifiez chaque sortie séparément car deux photos ne réagissent pas de la même manière aux mêmes réglages.
related: Exigences de photo de passeport en Afrique
faq: La compression modifie-t-elle les dimensions ?
Elle peut le faire. La qualité et le redimensionnement sont deux réglages distincts. Contrôlez les pixels après téléchargement.
Faut-il choisir JPEG ou PNG ?
Choisissez un format accepté. Le JPEG convient souvent aux photos; le PNG protège mieux les traits nets et la transparence mais peut être plus lourd.
Puis-je supprimer l'original après l'envoi ?
Conservez-le jusqu'à l'acceptation du dossier et son archivage. Une autre sortie peut être demandée.

steps: Fungua tovuti inayopokea na andika masharti yake ya sasa.
Tengeneza nakala ya picha ya awali na ufungue nakala kwenye zana.
Chagua aina inayokubalika na hifadhi uwiano wa picha.

details: Picha za kawaida huvumilia ubanaji wenye upotevu kuliko skani yenye maandishi madogo, mistari au sahihi. PNG huhifadhi kingo na uwazi lakini inaweza kuwa kubwa. JPEG hufaa kwa picha nyingi. Tumia WebP tu ikiwa tovuti imekubali wazi.
Usiamue kwa kijipicha pekee. Fungua faili uliyopakua, thibitisha ukubwa na vipimo, kisha karibia sehemu muhimu. Faili ndogo haina maana ikiwa uso au maandishi hayasomeki.
Ikiwa faili inaonekana kufuata masharti lakini inakataliwa, kagua jina, kiendelezi, mwelekeo na aina halisi. Picha ya skrini inaweza kupunguza ubora bila kutatua tatizo.
checks: Faili iko chini ya kikomo kilichoandikwa.
Upana, urefu na uwiano vinafuata masharti.
Uso, maandishi, muhuri na sahihi vinaonekana vizuri.
Kiendelezi kinafanana na aina iliyopakuliwa.
Faili ya awali bado imehifadhiwa.
sw.safety: Picha za maombi zinaweza kuwa na taarifa za utambulisho. Tumia uchakataji wa ndani inapowezekana na pakia kupitia tovuti rasmi pekee.
sw.toolUse: Unaweza kubana picha nyingi, lakini kagua kila faili kwa sababu picha tofauti huathiriwa tofauti na mpangilio mmoja.
faq: Je, kubana hubadilisha vipimo?
Inaweza. Ubora na kubadilisha vipimo ni vidhibiti tofauti, kwa hiyo kagua pikseli baada ya kupakua.

Tumia aina inayokubalika. JPEG mara nyingi hufaa kwa picha; PNG huhifadhi kingo na uwazi lakini inaweza kuwa kubwa.
Naweza kufuta faili ya awali baada ya kupakia?
Ihifadhi hadi ombi likubaliwe na kuwekwa salama. Huenda ukahitaji toleo jingine.

en.keyword: QR code generator for small business
en.title: QR Code Generator Guide for African Small Businesses
en.description: Create a QR code for WhatsApp, Wi-Fi, menus, payments or product links, then test the destination before printing.
en.imageAlt: QR code for a small-business link being tested
en.opening: A QR code is useful only when it sends the customer to the right destination and still scans after printing. The important work is preparing a stable link, choosing a clear call to action and testing the final artwork on more than one phone.
en.answer: Create the destination first, remove unnecessary tracking or private data, generate the code, download a high-quality version and test the printed size before ordering signs, stickers or packaging.
en.toolIntro: creates QR codes for links, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi and other common business actions.
en.quick: Use one code for one clear action. Tell the customer what will happen after scanning, such as viewing a menu or opening WhatsApp. Keep the destination active and assign someone to test it regularly.
inputs: Final URL, WhatsApp link, Wi-Fi details or text
The one thing the customer should do
Actual size on poster, label, receipt or packaging
A short readable URL or contact method
Person responsible for keeping the destination live
en.inputNote: Do not encode secrets, passwords for public display or personal data that should not be copied by anyone with a camera.
steps: Open and verify the destination on a clean browser.
Generate the QR code using the exact final content.
Download PNG for simple digital use or SVG for scalable print where supported.
Place the code with quiet space around it and a plain-language call to action.
Test the final digital file and one physical proof on different phones.
en.detailTitle: Design for scanning, trust and maintenance
details: A decorative code may look attractive but fail when contrast is weak, modules are covered or the quiet border disappears. Start with dark modules on a light background and make branding secondary to scan reliability.
A QR code does not prove that a payment request, website or Wi-Fi network is trustworthy. Show the business name and destination beside the code so a customer can judge it before scanning.
If the destination may change, use a redirect you control and document who can update it. Avoid a third-party shortener that could expire or be reassigned without warning.
checks: The destination opens without login surprises or certificate warnings.
The code scans from the expected distance and printed size.
A readable fallback link or contact is present.
The call to action matches what opens after scanning.
No private credential is embedded in public artwork.
en.safety: Treat payment QR codes as financial instructions. Confirm the merchant identity and receiving account through a trusted channel before publishing or paying.
en.toolUse: Save the source text with the exported code so the destination can be audited later without relying on the image alone.
faq: Should I download PNG or SVG?
PNG is convenient for screens and basic documents. SVG stays sharp at different print sizes when the design tool and printer support it.
Can I change the destination later?
A static code keeps the encoded value. To change it, generate a new code or encode a redirect URL that you control.
How do I know it will scan after printing?
Print a proof at the final size and test it on multiple phones, in ordinary lighting, before ordering the full batch.

Testez le fichier final et une épreuve imprimée sur plusieurs téléphones.
fr.detailTitle: Concevoir pour le scan, la confiance et la maintenance
details: Un code décoratif peut échouer si le contraste est faible ou si sa bordure disparaît. Commencez par des modules foncés sur fond clair et placez la marque après la fiabilité.
Un code QR ne prouve pas qu'un paiement ou un site est fiable. Affichez le nom de l'entreprise et la destination à côté pour permettre un contrôle avant le scan.
Si le lien doit évoluer, utilisez une redirection que vous contrôlez et documentez son responsable. Un raccourcisseur tiers peut expirer sans prévenir.
checks: La destination s'ouvre sans avertissement inattendu.
Le code fonctionne à la distance et à la taille prévues.
Une URL ou un contact de secours est visible.
La consigne correspond à la page ouverte.
Aucun identifiant privé n'est exposé.
fr.safety: Un code de paiement constitue une instruction financière. Vérifiez le commerçant et le compte bénéficiaire par un canal fiable.
fr.toolUse: Conservez le texte source avec l'image exportée afin de pouvoir auditer la destination plus tard.
faq: PNG ou SVG ?
Le PNG convient aux écrans et documents simples. Le SVG reste net à plusieurs tailles lorsque le logiciel et l'imprimeur le prennent en charge.
Peut-on changer le lien après ?
Un code statique conserve la valeur encodée. Générez un nouveau code ou utilisez une redirection que vous contrôlez.
Comment vérifier l'impression ?
Imprimez une épreuve à la taille finale et testez-la avec plusieurs téléphones avant la série complète.

QR code haithibitishi kuwa malipo au tovuti ni salama. Onyesha jina la biashara na mahali pa kwenda ili mteja aweze kukagua kabla ya kuskani.
Ikiwa kiungo kitabadilika, tumia uelekezaji unaoudhibiti na andika mwenye jukumu. Huduma ya kufupisha kiungo inaweza kuisha bila taarifa.
checks: Kiungo kinafunguka bila onyo lisilotarajiwa.
Code inasomeka kwa umbali na ukubwa uliopangwa.
Kuna kiungo au mawasiliano ya dharura.
Maelekezo yanafanana na ukurasa unaofunguka.
Hakuna taarifa ya siri kwenye picha ya umma.
sw.safety: QR code ya malipo ni agizo la kifedha. Thibitisha biashara na akaunti ya mpokeaji kupitia njia unayoamini.
sw.toolUse: Hifadhi maandishi yaliyowekwa pamoja na picha ili uweze kukagua mahali pa kwenda baadaye.
faq: Nitapakua PNG au SVG?
PNG ni rahisi kwa skrini na nyaraka. SVG hubaki wazi katika ukubwa tofauti ikiwa programu na mchapishaji vinaikubali.
Naweza kubadilisha kiungo baadaye?
Code tuli hubaki na thamani ileile. Tengeneza nyingine au tumia kiungo cha uelekezaji unachodhibiti.

Chapisha mfano kwa ukubwa wa mwisho na ujaribu kwa simu kadhaa kabla ya kuagiza nyingi.

en.title: Meeting Minutes Template: Decisions, Owners and Deadlines
en.description: Write concise meeting minutes that record decisions, action owners, due dates and unresolved items without producing a transcript.
en.imageAlt: Meeting minutes with decisions and action owners
en.opening: Good minutes are not a transcript. They are a reliable record of what the group considered, decided and assigned. The most useful version is short enough to review quickly and precise enough to settle later confusion.
en.answer: Prepare the agenda before the meeting, capture each decision in neutral language, give every action one owner and due date, circulate the draft promptly, and record approval or corrections.
en.toolIntro: organises attendees, agenda items, decisions and actions and supports practical exports.
en.quick: For every agenda item, write the decision, the reason needed for context, the action, one accountable owner and the due date. Mark unresolved items as open instead of implying agreement.
inputs: Date, time, purpose and location or channel
Exact outcome, including abstentions or conflicts where relevant
Owner, due date and evidence of completion
en.inputNote: If the meeting follows a constitution, board charter or law, confirm quorum, voting and approval requirements separately.
steps: Prepare an agenda and minutes shell before the meeting.
Record attendance, conflicts and whether the meeting can validly proceed.
Capture decisions and actions as they happen, using neutral language.
Review ambiguous points with the chair before circulation.
Send the draft promptly, log corrections and preserve the approved version.
en.detailTitle: Write minutes people can act on
details: Summarise discussion only when it explains a decision, risk or dissent. Avoid personal commentary and do not attribute a view unless attribution is necessary or required.
An action without one accountable owner is likely to disappear. Contributors can be listed, but one person should own the next update and the evidence that closes the item.
Keep confidential annexes separate from general minutes. Access to sensitive employment, legal, financial or personal matters should follow the organisation's policy.
checks: Attendance, quorum and conflicts are recorded where relevant.
Each decision is distinguishable from discussion or proposal.
Every action has one owner and a realistic due date.
Open questions are clearly marked and carried forward.
The approved version and any attachments have controlled access.
en.safety: Do not record unnecessary personal data or speculative accusations. Follow the applicable records, employment and data-protection rules for your organisation.
en.toolUse: Use calendar export for due dates and CSV or PDF only after names, decisions and confidential fields have been reviewed.
faq: Do minutes need every spoken word?
Usually no. Capture the material discussion, decisions, actions and required procedural facts, subject to your governing rules.
Who approves the minutes?
Follow the organisation's rules. Commonly the chair reviews the draft and the next meeting formally approves it.
Can action items live separately?
Yes, but link the action register to the approved minutes so the source decision remains traceable.

fr.keyword: modèle de compte rendu de réunion
fr.title: Modèle de compte rendu de réunion avec décisions et actions
fr.description: Rédigez un compte rendu concis avec décisions, responsables, échéances et points ouverts, sans produire une transcription.

fr.opening: Un bon compte rendu n'est pas une transcription. Il conserve ce que le groupe a examiné, décidé et attribué. Il doit rester rapide à relire et assez précis pour résoudre un désaccord ultérieur.
fr.answer: Préparez l'ordre du jour, formulez chaque décision de manière neutre, donnez un responsable et une échéance à chaque action, diffusez rapidement le projet et consignez les corrections.
fr.toolIntro: structure les participants, sujets, décisions et actions dans un document réutilisable.
fr.quick: Pour chaque sujet, notez la décision, le contexte utile, l'action, un responsable et la date limite. Marquez les questions non résolues comme ouvertes.
inputs: Date, heure, objectif et lieu ou canal
Résultat exact, abstention ou conflit si nécessaire
Responsable, échéance et preuve de clôture
fr.inputNote: Si une loi, des statuts ou un règlement encadrent la réunion, vérifiez séparément le quorum, le vote et l'approbation.
steps: Préparez l'ordre du jour et la trame avant la réunion.
Notez les présences, conflits et conditions de validité.
Saisissez les décisions et actions en langage neutre.
Clarifiez les points ambigus avec la présidence.
Diffusez le projet, consignez les corrections et archivez la version approuvée.
fr.detailTitle: Rédiger un document orienté vers l'action
details: Résumez la discussion uniquement lorsqu'elle explique une décision, un risque ou un désaccord. Évitez le commentaire personnel.
Une action sans responsable unique risque de disparaître. Plusieurs contributeurs sont possibles, mais une personne doit porter la prochaine mise à jour.
Séparez les annexes confidentielles du compte rendu général et limitez l'accès aux sujets personnels, juridiques ou financiers.
checks: Présence, quorum et conflits sont indiqués si nécessaire.
Chaque décision se distingue d'une proposition.
Chaque action possède un responsable et une échéance.
Les questions ouvertes sont reportées clairement.
La version approuvée et ses annexes sont protégées.
fr.safety: Ne consignez pas de données personnelles inutiles ni d'accusations spéculatives. Respectez les règles internes et la protection des données.
fr.toolUse: N'exportez le calendrier, le CSV ou le PDF qu'après relecture des noms, décisions et champs confidentiels.
faq: Faut-il noter chaque mot ?
Généralement non. Conservez la discussion utile, les décisions, les actions et les faits de procédure exigés.
Qui approuve le compte rendu ?
Suivez les règles de l'organisation. La présidence relit souvent le projet avant une approbation formelle.
Peut-on séparer la liste d'actions ?
Oui, mais reliez-la au compte rendu approuvé pour conserver la décision d'origine.

en.title: NDA Template Guide for African Businesses and Freelancers
en.description: Prepare a practical non-disclosure agreement draft by defining the parties, confidential information, purpose, duration and exclusions.
en.imageAlt: NDA draft with confidential information and signatures
en.opening: An NDA is useful when the parties can identify what is confidential, why it is being shared and what the recipient may do with it. A generic document with the wrong parties or jurisdiction can create false confidence.
en.answer: Decide whether the NDA is one-way or mutual, identify the legal parties, define the permitted purpose, include sensible exclusions and handling duties, then ask a qualified local lawyer to review important or unusual deals.
en.toolIntro: helps prepare a structured draft for review; it does not replace jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
en.quick: Do not disclose the sensitive material before the protection and receiving party are clear. Mark shared files, limit access, keep a disclosure log and use the signed agreement as one part of a wider confidentiality process.
inputs: Registered names, addresses and authorised signatories
Specific categories and any marked materials
Why the recipient may use the information
Duration, survival and jurisdiction for review
en.inputNote: Employee, investor, supplier, customer and joint-development discussions can require different clauses. Avoid forcing one template onto every relationship.
steps: Identify the disclosing and receiving legal persons.
Describe the business purpose and confidential categories in plain language.
Choose one-way or mutual duties and record permitted recipients.
Review exclusions, return or destruction, duration, remedies and governing law.
Obtain legal review where the value, jurisdiction or negotiation risk is material, then sign before disclosure.
en.detailTitle: Make the agreement match the real information flow
details: Confidential information should be broad enough to cover the intended material but clear enough that the recipient can comply. Common exclusions address information already public, already known, independently developed or lawfully received elsewhere.

An NDA does not secure a careless workflow. Limit access, mark sensitive files, record who received them and use secure storage. At the end of the relationship, follow the agreed return or destruction process.
Non-compete, intellectual-property ownership, data processing and employment restrictions are separate issues. Their enforceability varies, so do not add them casually to a confidentiality template.
checks: The legal names and signatory authority are correct.
The permitted purpose is specific and practical.
Definitions, exclusions and disclosure duties fit the transaction.
Duration, governing law and dispute terms have been reviewed locally.
Operational controls support the promises in the document.
en.safety: This is document preparation, not legal advice. Do not upload trade secrets or personal data to an untrusted service merely to create a template.
en.toolUse: Generate a draft with placeholders resolved, export it, compare it with the agreed commercial terms and send it for appropriate review before signature.
faq: Should the NDA be mutual?
Use a mutual NDA when both parties will disclose protected information. Use a one-way NDA when only one party is expected to disclose.
How long should confidentiality last?
It depends on the information, law and transaction. Some obligations use a fixed period; valuable trade secrets may need different treatment.
Does an NDA stop every leak?
No. It supports enforcement and expectations, but access control, secure handling and careful disclosure remain necessary.

fr.opening: Un NDA est utile lorsque les parties savent ce qui est confidentiel, pourquoi l'information est partagée et comment le destinataire peut l'utiliser. Un modèle générique avec de mauvaises parties crée une fausse sécurité.
fr.answer: Choisissez un accord unilatéral ou mutuel, identifiez les parties juridiques, définissez l'objectif autorisé, les exclusions et les obligations de protection, puis faites relire les opérations importantes par un juriste local.
fr.toolIntro: prépare un projet structuré à relire; il ne remplace pas un conseil juridique adapté au pays.
fr.quick: Ne transmettez pas l'information sensible avant d'avoir identifié la protection et le destinataire. Marquez les fichiers, limitez les accès et conservez un registre de transmission.
inputs: Période, survie et juridiction à relire
fr.inputNote: Un salarié, un investisseur, un fournisseur et un partenaire de développement ne nécessitent pas toujours les mêmes clauses.
steps: Identifiez les personnes juridiques qui divulguent et reçoivent.
Décrivez l'objectif et les catégories confidentielles en langage clair.
Choisissez les obligations unilatérales ou mutuelles et les destinataires autorisés.
Relisez exclusions, restitution, durée, recours et droit applicable.
Obtenez une relecture juridique lorsque l'enjeu ou la juridiction le justifie, puis signez avant la divulgation.
fr.detailTitle: Adapter l'accord au flux réel d'informations
details: La définition doit couvrir le contenu prévu tout en permettant au destinataire de comprendre ses obligations. Les exclusions courantes concernent les informations publiques, déjà connues, développées indépendamment ou reçues légalement.
Un NDA ne sécurise pas une organisation négligente. Limitez l'accès, marquez les fichiers, consignez les destinataires et utilisez un stockage fiable.
La non-concurrence, la propriété intellectuelle, le traitement des données et le droit du travail sont des sujets distincts dont la validité varie.
checks: Les noms juridiques et pouvoirs de signature sont corrects.
L'objectif autorisé est précis.
Les définitions et exclusions correspondent à l'opération.
La durée et le droit applicable ont été relus localement.
Les mesures internes permettent de respecter le document.
fr.safety: Il s'agit d'une préparation documentaire, pas d'un avis juridique. Ne téléversez pas de secret d'affaires dans un service non fiable.
fr.toolUse: Générez un projet complet, comparez-le aux conditions commerciales convenues et obtenez la relecture appropriée avant signature.
faq: Faut-il un NDA mutuel ?
Choisissez-le lorsque les deux parties divulguent des informations protégées. Un accord unilatéral convient à une divulgation dans un seul sens.
Quelle durée choisir ?
Elle dépend de l'information, de la loi et de l'opération. Un secret d'affaires peut nécessiter un traitement différent d'une information temporaire.
Le NDA empêche-t-il toute fuite ?
Non. Il encadre les obligations, mais le contrôle des accès et la prudence restent indispensables.

en.imageAlt: Study-abroad budget with tuition, travel and living costs
en.opening: The headline tuition fee is not the full cost of studying abroad. A usable plan includes deposits, visa and document costs, travel, housing setup, insurance, monthly living costs, emergency money and the timing of each payment.
en.answer: Use official admission and fee documents, collect dated quotes, convert every item into one planning currency with a recorded rate, subtract only confirmed funding, and keep a pressure case for exchange-rate and housing changes.
en.toolIntro: builds a private one-currency plan from values you verify instead of relying on stale country averages.
en.quick: Separate one-time costs from monthly costs and separate confirmed money from hoped-for scholarships or work. The cash-flow calendar matters as much as the total because deposits can be due before funding arrives.
inputs: Official offer, fee schedule and refund terms
Official visa, permit, translation and test requirements
Dated flight, housing deposit and initial equipment quotes
Monthly housing, food, transport, communication and health plan
Confirmed award letters, savings and dated exchange-rate assumption
en.inputNote: Do not count a scholarship application, promised family support or possible part-time work as confirmed funding until written evidence exists.
steps: Collect the admission offer and official programme fee schedule.
List one-time, recurring and refundable costs separately.
Choose one planning currency and record the date and source for each conversion.
Map payment due dates against confirmed funding dates.
Run a pressure case for currency movement, delayed funding and higher housing cost.
en.detailTitle: Plan the total and the payment timeline
details: Tuition may exclude registration, laboratory, fieldwork, student services or mandatory insurance. Ask the institution for the complete fee schedule and identify which payments are refundable if a visa is refused.
Housing can require a deposit, guarantor, advance rent or temporary accommodation. Budget the arrival period separately because the first month is often more expensive than a normal month.
Recognition, visa and work rights are separate questions. Verify the programme and qualification, then use the official immigration source for the exact passport, nationality and study route.
checks: Every major amount has a dated source.
One-time and monthly costs are separated.
Funding is labelled confirmed, conditional or unconfirmed.
Payment dates fit the available cash timeline.
A return or emergency reserve is not hidden inside tuition.
en.safety: Use synthetic labels in shared budgets. Store admission letters, passport details and bank evidence privately and submit them only through official channels.
en.toolUse: Save a base, pressure and reduced-scope version so the decision remains clear if a fee, exchange rate or funding date changes.
faq: Should I use today's exchange rate?
Use a dated rate for the base plan and add a pressure scenario. The payment-day rate may differ.
Can I include part-time work?
Treat it as unconfirmed unless your visa permits it and the income is reliably arranged. Do not use hoped-for work to cover required upfront funds.
What cost is most often missed?
Arrival costs, deposits, insurance, document processing and the timing gap before funding are common omissions.

en.title: Prepaid Meter Units and Monthly Electricity Guide
en.description: Estimate prepaid electricity units from the current tariff, service charges and taxes, then compare planned and actual consumption.
en.imageAlt: Prepaid electricity units and monthly household budget
en.opening: The amount paid for a prepaid token is not always divided by one simple tariff. Fixed charges, taxes, debt recovery, account type and stepped pricing can change the units delivered.
en.answer: Use the latest utility tariff or receipt, subtract verified deductions, apply the correct energy rate and compare the estimate with the token receipt. Treat the result as a budget, not a guaranteed vend.
en.toolIntro: lets you enter a country, token amount, service charges and account assumptions.
en.quick: Begin with the most recent token receipt because it shows what actually happened on your account. Estimate days of supply from your own daily use, then update the plan after each purchase.
inputs: Current written energy rate or band
Tax, service charge, debt or other receipt line
Residential, business, lifeline or another class
Recent meter difference or appliance estimate
en.inputNote: A country average cannot replace the tariff and deductions on a specific utility account.
steps: Find the latest official tariff notice and your recent receipt.
Identify the portion available to buy energy after deductions.
Apply the correct rate or stepped band without mixing units.
Estimate days of supply using recent household consumption.
Compare the estimate with the actual token and revise the next budget.
details: A higher payment does not always buy units at the same average rate when tariffs are stepped or a monthly threshold applies. The sequence and timing of purchases may matter.
Debt recovery, tax or service charges reduce the amount buying electricity. Record each deduction separately instead of hiding it inside an assumed unit price.
Estimate appliances with realistic hours and power ratings, but prefer meter readings for the whole home. Fridges, pumps and air conditioners cycle rather than drawing their label power continuously.
checks: The tariff and account class are current.
Charges and taxes are separated from energy value.
Currency, kWh and money units are not mixed.
The estimate is compared with the actual receipt.
An unexpected difference is raised with the utility, not guessed away.
en.safety: Do not tamper with a meter or buy tokens through an unverified seller. Use the utility's official support route for rejected tokens or account disputes.
en.toolUse: Save actual units after each purchase to build a household-specific pattern instead of relying indefinitely on the first estimate.
faq: Why did the same amount buy fewer units?
Tariff bands, monthly thresholds, taxes, debt or service deductions may have changed. Compare both receipts line by line.
Can I calculate days of supply exactly?
No. Usage changes with appliances, weather and occupancy. Use recent meter data and a range.
What if the token is rejected?
Keep the receipt and reference, confirm the meter number, and contact the official utility or vendor support channel.

fr.opening: Le montant d'une recharge ne se divise pas toujours par un tarif unique. Frais fixes, taxes, dette, catégorie de client et tarification par tranches peuvent modifier les unités livrées.
fr.answer: Utilisez le tarif actuel et le dernier reçu, retirez les déductions vérifiées, appliquez le bon prix de l'énergie et comparez à la recharge réelle. Le résultat reste un budget.
fr.toolIntro: permet de saisir le montant, les frais et les hypothèses du compte.
fr.quick: Commencez par le reçu le plus récent. Estimez les jours à partir de votre consommation réelle, puis mettez le plan à jour après chaque achat.
inputs: Taxe, service, dette ou autre ligne
Écart du compteur ou estimation des appareils
fr.inputNote: Une moyenne nationale ne remplace pas le tarif et les déductions d'un compte précis.
steps: Trouvez le tarif officiel et votre dernier reçu.
Calculez la part qui achète réellement l'énergie.
Appliquez le bon tarif sans mélanger les unités.
Estimez la durée avec votre consommation récente.
Comparez aux unités reçues et corrigez le prochain budget.
details: Avec des tranches, un paiement plus élevé ne conserve pas toujours le même prix moyen. Le moment et l'ordre des achats peuvent compter.
Dette, taxe ou service réduisent la part destinée à l'énergie. Consignez chaque retenue séparément.
Les puissances d'appareils donnent une estimation. Les relevés du compteur décrivent mieux le foyer entier, car certains équipements fonctionnent par cycles.
checks: Le tarif et la catégorie sont actuels.
Les frais sont séparés de l'énergie.
Monnaie et kWh ne sont pas mélangés.
La prévision est comparée au reçu.
Un écart inexpliqué est signalé au fournisseur.
fr.safety: Ne modifiez pas le compteur et n'achetez pas auprès d'un vendeur non vérifié. Utilisez le support officiel en cas de rejet.
fr.toolUse: Enregistrez les unités réelles après chaque recharge pour construire une référence propre au foyer.
faq: Pourquoi le même montant donne-t-il moins d'unités ?
Les tranches, taxes, dettes ou frais peuvent changer. Comparez les deux reçus.
Peut-on connaître exactement le nombre de jours ?
Non. L'usage varie. Utilisez des relevés récents et une fourchette.
Que faire si le jeton est refusé ?
Gardez le reçu, vérifiez le numéro du compteur et contactez le fournisseur officiel.

en.title: African Visa Requirements Checklist Before You Book
en.description: Check visa-free, visa-on-arrival, eVisa or embassy routes, then verify passport, transit, health and entry rules officially.
en.imageAlt: African passport and visa requirement checklist
en.opening: Visa rules depend on nationality, passport type, destination, transit route, purpose and travel date. A social post or old list can be wrong even when it describes the same two countries.
en.answer: Use a checker to identify the likely route, then confirm it with the destination immigration authority, embassy or consulate and the airline's document system before paying non-refundable costs.
en.toolIntro: helps compare travel-document routes within Africa and shows source context where available.
en.quick: Check the passport you will actually use, every transit airport and the purpose of travel. Save dated screenshots or PDFs of official instructions and recheck close to departure.
inputs: Tourism, business, study, work or residence
Visa-free, arrival, eVisa or prior application
Current authority page, approval and airline check
en.inputNote: Visa-free entry can still require passport validity, blank pages, onward travel, funds, accommodation or health evidence.
steps: Enter nationality and destination into the checker.
Open the destination's official immigration or embassy source.
Check transit rules for every airport and border.
Verify passport validity, health, funds and supporting documents.
Recheck before departure and carry the approval or evidence required.
details: A checker is excellent for discovering the likely category, but it cannot approve entry. Border officials and authorised systems apply the current rule to the specific traveller.
An eVisa should be obtained only from the official domain or a clearly authorised provider. Search advertisements and lookalike websites can charge extra or collect passport data.
Airline boarding rules and destination entry rules interact. A traveller may also need transit permission even without leaving the airport.

Travelling with a child, diplomatic document, refugee travel document or emergency passport can trigger a different route. Check consent letters, birth records and document eligibility directly with the responsible authority.
checks: Nationality and passport type are correct.
Transit points and purpose are included.
The source is official and recently checked.
Approval names and passport details match exactly.
Non-refundable bookings wait until uncertainty is resolved.
en.safety: Passport scans and visa applications contain sensitive identity data. Use official encrypted portals and avoid sending full documents to unknown agents.
en.toolUse: Treat the result as a route finder. Follow the linked source trail and record the date of your confirmation.
faq: Does visa-free mean no documents?
No. Entry conditions such as passport validity, onward travel or accommodation can still apply.
Is visa on arrival guaranteed?
No. Eligibility and documents must still be satisfied, and the final decision is made by the competent authority.
When should I recheck?
Check before booking, before submitting documents and again close to departure because rules can change.

fr.title: Exigences de visa en Afrique: la checklist avant réservation

fr.imageAlt: Passeport africain et checklist des exigences de visa
fr.opening: Les règles dépendent de la nationalité, du passeport, de la destination, du transit, du motif et de la date. Une ancienne liste peut être fausse pour le même trajet.
fr.answer: Utilisez le vérificateur pour identifier la voie probable, puis confirmez auprès de l'immigration, de l'ambassade et du système documentaire de la compagnie avant toute dépense non remboursable.
fr.toolIntro: aide à comparer les voies documentaires et à retrouver le contexte des sources.
fr.quick: Vérifiez le passeport réellement utilisé, chaque transit et le motif du séjour. Conservez une preuve datée des instructions officielles et contrôlez de nouveau avant le départ.

Exemption, arrivée, eVisa ou demande préalable

fr.inputNote: Une exemption peut encore exiger validité, pages libres, retour, ressources, logement ou santé.
steps: Saisissez nationalité et destination.
Ouvrez la source officielle de la destination.
Contrôlez chaque transit.
Vérifiez passeport, santé, ressources et justificatifs.
Recontrôlez avant départ et emportez les preuves.
details: Le vérificateur indique une catégorie probable mais n'autorise pas l'entrée. Les autorités appliquent la règle au voyageur précis.
Demandez un eVisa uniquement sur le domaine officiel ou auprès d'un prestataire autorisé. Les sites ressemblants peuvent collecter le passeport.
Les règles d'embarquement et d'entrée se complètent. Un transit peut nécessiter une autorisation même sans sortie de l'aéroport.
checks: Nationalité et type de passeport sont exacts.
Transits et motif sont inclus.
La source est officielle et récente.
Nom et numéro correspondent à l'autorisation.
Les achats non remboursables attendent la résolution des doutes.
fr.safety: Les scans de passeport sont sensibles. Utilisez des portails officiels sécurisés et évitez les agents inconnus.
fr.toolUse: Utilisez le résultat pour trouver la voie, puis suivez les sources et notez la date de confirmation.
faq: Sans visa signifie-t-il sans documents ?
Non. Validité du passeport, retour, logement ou autres preuves peuvent rester exigés.
Le visa à l'arrivée est-il garanti ?
Non. Il faut rester éligible et satisfaire les documents; l'autorité décide.
Quand revérifier ?
Avant réservation, avant dépôt et peu avant le départ.

en.title: ATS-Readable CV Guide for African Job Applications
en.description: Create a clear CV with evidence-led achievements, simple structure, relevant keywords and a private export workflow.
en.imageAlt: ATS-readable CV layout with skills and achievements
en.opening: An ATS-readable CV is not a document stuffed with keywords. It is a clear record whose headings, dates, roles, skills and achievements can be understood by software and by a recruiter.
en.answer: Use standard headings, simple chronology, job-relevant language and measurable evidence. Keep contact details accurate, avoid decorative text boxes for essential content and reopen the exported PDF before applying.
en.toolIntro: helps structure an Africa-ready CV and export it locally for review.
en.quick: Read the vacancy, identify the genuine skills and outcomes it asks for, then show where your experience proves them. Never claim a credential, employer, result or tool you cannot support.
inputs: Professional, current and safe to share
en.inputNote: Keep a master CV, then make a focused copy for each role. Do not overwrite the source while tailoring.
steps: Extract the role's real requirements without copying entire paragraphs.
Choose experience that demonstrates those requirements.
Write concise bullets with action, context and outcome.
Use standard headings and a simple reading order.
Export, reopen, copy text out and proofread before submission.
en.detailTitle: Balance parsing, evidence and human readability
details: Tables, columns, icons and text boxes can create a confusing extraction order. A clean single-column structure is a safer default when an employer gives no template.
Keywords should describe real capability. Use the employer's terminology where it accurately matches your experience, but do not repeat phrases unnaturally.
Numbers are useful only when they are honest and understandable. Add scope, baseline or timeframe where needed, and protect confidential employer data.
checks: Name, email, phone and links are accurate.
Dates and roles do not contradict each other.
Important text can be selected and copied from the PDF.
The strongest relevant evidence appears early.
The filename is professional and does not reveal unnecessary private data.
en.safety: CVs contain identity and employment data. Keep drafts local by default, use synthetic details in public examples and send only the final document through the employer's trusted channel.
en.toolUse: Build locally, export the final PDF and keep a text or JSON backup if offered so future edits do not depend on one file.
faq: Does ATS-friendly mean plain and ugly?
No. It means clear hierarchy and reliable text extraction. Typography and spacing can still look professional.
Should every CV be one page?
No universal rule applies. Use the shortest length that presents relevant evidence clearly without tiny text.
Can I use the same CV for every job?
Keep one accurate master, then tailor a copy to the genuine requirements of each role.

Rédigez des puces avec action, contexte et résultat.

Les chiffres doivent être honnêtes et contextualisés. Protégez les données confidentielles de l'ancien employeur.

Le texte important se copie depuis le PDF.

fr.toolUse: Créez le CV localement, exportez le PDF et conservez une sauvegarde modifiable si elle est proposée.

Non. Il faut surtout une hiérarchie claire et une extraction fiable.
Le CV doit-il tenir sur une page ?
Il n'existe pas de règle universelle. Soyez aussi court que possible sans supprimer les preuves utiles.
Puis-je utiliser le même CV partout ?
Gardez un maître exact puis adaptez une copie aux exigences réelles du poste.

en.title: How to Remove an Image Background and Export a Clean PNG
en.description: Create a transparent product, profile or design image, refine difficult edges and verify the exported PNG before publishing.
en.imageAlt: Product image with background removed and transparent PNG export
en.opening: Automatic background removal is a starting mask, not proof of a finished image. Hair, transparent objects, shadows and colours similar to the background often need a manual edge check.
en.answer: Use the highest-quality original, generate the cutout, inspect it on light and dark backgrounds, refine missing or extra areas, then export PNG when transparency is required.
en.toolIntro: supports automatic cutout, colour key, brush refinement and local exports.
en.quick: Zoom into hair, fingers, product handles, glass and shadow edges. A cutout that looks acceptable on a checkerboard can show a halo on the final poster or marketplace background.
inputs: Person, product or object to retain
Marketplace, CV, flyer, catalogue or social post
Transparent, solid colour or replacement image
Pixel dimensions, format and file-size limit
en.inputNote: Confirm you have permission to edit and publish the image, especially for client photos, trademarks and marketplace listings.
steps: Open a high-quality original with clear subject separation.
Run the automatic cutout and inspect the full outline.
Use restore and erase controls on difficult edges.
Preview against light, dark and intended backgrounds.
Export PNG for transparency or the required flattened format, then reopen it.
en.detailTitle: Refine edges for the final destination
details: Transparent PNG stores opacity information, but another application may flatten it onto white or black. Test the file in the actual destination before deleting the working copy.
A soft natural shadow can make a product feel grounded. Removing every semi-transparent pixel may create a harsh sticker effect, while keeping the old background halo looks untidy.
Small final images need a different check from large design assets. Review at actual display size and at zoom so you catch both visible halos and lost fine detail.
checks: No part of the subject is accidentally missing.
Old background colour does not form a visible halo.
Transparent output is actually PNG or another supported alpha format.
The image looks correct on the intended background.
Dimensions and file size meet the destination rule.
en.safety: Do not upload private portraits or client assets to an unknown service. Remove metadata when appropriate and keep consent and licensing records.
en.toolUse: Process locally where supported, keep the original and export versions for each destination rather than stretching one low-resolution cutout.
faq: Why is there a white background after download?
The file may have been saved as JPEG or flattened by another app. Export PNG and test it in software that supports transparency.
How do I remove a halo?
Inspect on a contrasting background and refine the edge. Sometimes reducing colour spill or restoring a thin part of the subject helps.
Can I use any image I find online?
No. Background removal does not grant copyright, trademark or model permission.

details: Le PNG conserve la transparence, mais une autre application peut l'aplatir. Testez dans la destination réelle.
Une ombre douce peut ancrer le produit. Supprimer chaque pixel semi-transparent donne parfois un effet d'autocollant.
Contrôlez à la taille réelle et en zoom pour repérer halos et détails perdus.
checks: Aucune partie du sujet ne manque.

en.title: GPA and CGPA Guide for African University Students
en.description: Calculate a credit-weighted semester GPA and cumulative CGPA using the grading scale published by your institution.
en.imageAlt: University grades, course credits and GPA calculation
en.opening: GPA is not calculated from marks alone. Course credits, grade points, repeated courses, failed courses and the institution's own policy determine the result.
en.answer: Copy the official grade-point table, multiply each course grade point by its credit value, add the quality points and divide by counted credits. For CGPA, follow the institution's rules for all included semesters and repeats.
en.toolIntro: supports private credit-weighted calculations with a grading table you verify.
en.quick: Do not borrow a 4-point or 5-point scale from another university. Use the current handbook for your programme and compare the worksheet with the official transcript.
inputs: Rules for repeats, fails, exemptions and rounding
en.inputNote: A simple average of course marks is not the same as a credit-weighted GPA unless the institution explicitly defines it that way.
steps: Find the current official grading and progression policy.
List every counted course with its credit and grade.
Map each grade to the correct grade point.
Multiply grade point by credit, total both columns and divide.
Compare with the official result and ask the registrar about differences.
en.detailTitle: Handle repeats, exclusions and conversion carefully
details: Institutions differ on whether a repeated course replaces the old result, adds another attempt or affects progression separately. Follow the written policy rather than deleting an inconvenient grade.
Rounding only at the end avoids cumulative error. Keep enough decimal places in the worksheet and display the number of places used by the institution.
Converting GPA between systems is not a universal arithmetic operation. Scholarship and admissions bodies may use their own evaluation, so submit the official transcript and scale when requested.
checks: The scale belongs to the correct institution and programme year.
Credits and grade points are in separate columns.
All counted courses are included once according to policy.
Rounding is applied only as the institution specifies.
The worksheet is labelled unofficial until matched to the transcript.
en.safety: Academic records are personal data. Keep the worksheet private, avoid publishing student numbers and use the registrar's official process for corrections.
en.toolUse: Save the grading scale beside the calculation so the result can be reproduced when a policy or application asks for evidence.
faq: Is GPA the average of my marks?
Usually not. GPA commonly weights grade points by course credits, but the institution's policy controls.
How do repeats affect CGPA?
Rules differ. Some replace, retain or separately flag attempts. Use the current academic handbook.
Can I convert a 5.0 GPA to 4.0 by proportion?
A simple proportion may not match the receiving institution's evaluation. Provide the official scale and follow its stated method.

fr.title: Calculer son GPA et CGPA dans une université africaine
fr.description: Calculez une moyenne pondérée par crédits avec le barème officiel de votre établissement et contrôlez le résultat avec le relevé.
fr.imageAlt: Notes universitaires, crédits et calcul du GPA
fr.opening: Le GPA ne dépend pas seulement des notes. Les crédits, points, reprises, échecs et règles propres à l'établissement déterminent le résultat.
fr.answer: Copiez le barème officiel, multipliez le point de chaque note par les crédits, additionnez les points pondérés et divisez par les crédits comptés. Pour le CGPA, suivez la règle des semestres et reprises.
fr.toolIntro: permet un calcul privé avec un barème que vous vérifiez.
fr.quick: N'utilisez pas le barème d'une autre université. Prenez le règlement actuel de votre programme et comparez au relevé officiel.
fr.inputNote: La moyenne simple des notes n'est pas un GPA pondéré sauf définition contraire de l'établissement.
steps: Trouvez le règlement actuel.
Listez chaque cours compté avec crédits et note.
Associez chaque note au bon point.
Multipliez, totalisez puis divisez par les crédits.
Comparez au relevé et signalez les écarts au service compétent.
fr.detailTitle: Traiter les reprises et conversions avec prudence
details: Les règles de reprise diffèrent. Ne supprimez pas une ancienne note sans base écrite.
Arrondissez à la fin pour éviter les erreurs cumulées et utilisez le nombre de décimales officiel.
La conversion entre systèmes n'est pas universelle. Le destinataire peut effectuer sa propre évaluation.
checks: Le barème correspond à l'année et au programme.
Crédits et points sont séparés.
Chaque cours est inclus selon la règle.
L'arrondi suit le règlement.
Le calcul reste non officiel avant rapprochement.
fr.safety: Les relevés sont des données personnelles. Masquez le numéro étudiant et utilisez la procédure officielle pour toute correction.
fr.toolUse: Conservez le barème avec le calcul pour permettre sa reproduction.
faq: Le GPA est-il la moyenne de mes notes ?
Généralement non. Il pondère souvent les points par les crédits selon le règlement.
Comment compter une reprise ?
Les règles varient. Consultez le manuel actuel.
Puis-je convertir 5,0 vers 4,0 par proportion ?
Cette conversion peut être refusée. Fournissez le barème officiel et suivez la méthode du destinataire.

sw.opening: GPA haitokani na alama pekee. Credits, pointi, kurudia kozi, kufeli na kanuni za chuo huamua matokeo.
sw.answer: Nakili jedwali rasmi, zidisha pointi ya kila daraja kwa credits, jumlisha pointi zenye uzito na ugawanye kwa credits. Kwa CGPA fuata sheria za mihula na kurudia.

steps: Tafuta kanuni rasmi ya sasa.
Orodhesha kila kozi, credits na daraja.

Zidisha, jumlisha na ugawanye kwa credits.
Linganisha na matokeo rasmi na uliza ofisi kuhusu tofauti.
sw.detailTitle: Shughulikia kurudia na ubadilishaji kwa uangalifu
details: Vyuo hutofautiana kuhusu kozi iliyorudiwa. Usifute daraja la zamani bila kanuni iliyoandikwa.
Zungusha mwisho wa hesabu ili kupunguza kosa na tumia nafasi za desimali za chuo.
Kubadilisha GPA kati ya mizani si hesabu moja ya dunia. Taasisi inayopokea inaweza kufanya tathmini yake.

Credits na pointi ziko kwenye safu tofauti.
Kozi zimejumuishwa kwa kanuni.
Kuzungusha kumefuata utaratibu.

sw.toolUse: Hifadhi mizani pamoja na hesabu ili mtu aweze kurudia matokeo.
faq: GPA ni wastani wa alama?
Mara nyingi hapana. Kwa kawaida pointi huzidishwa kwa credits kulingana na kanuni.
Kozi iliyorudiwa huhesabiwaje?
Kanuni hutofautiana. Soma kitabu cha sasa cha chuo.
Naweza kubadilisha 5.0 kuwa 4.0 kwa uwiano?
Huenda njia hiyo isikubalike. Toa mizani rasmi na fuata njia ya taasisi inayopokea.
